title: AchievementDef
description:
An achievement definition from JSON type `"achievement"`.

Defines an achievement that can be unlocked by the player.

description.description: Description text (can be a plain string or structured object).

hidden.description: Whether this achievement is hidden until unlocked.

manual_completion.description: Whether this is a manually given achievement ("manually_given" in JSON).

name.description: Display name (can be a plain string, structured object, or missing).

LocalizedString.description:
A localized string that may contain translations for multiple languages.

In CDDA JSON, this appears as: ```json { "str": "name", "//~": "context" } { "str_sp": "name" }           // same for singular & plural { "str_pl": "names" }          // explicit plural ``` Or as a plain string `"name"`.

For Stage 1 we store the raw English text. Full i18n support (extracting translations) is deferred.

anyOf.description: A localized object with optional plural and context.
